Modern performance: accelAlloc warnings in 25 minutes

The receiver has 5400 kB of fast graphics memory. Every run below repeats the same round: channel list fast and slow, EventView, SecondInfoBar, EPG, EMC on the USB folder, and a channel change. Counts include the one warning every start-up logs. Fewer is better; nothing was lost on screen in any run, the warning means the picture went to normal memory.
